title: Composition on honeycomb tori reaches every ring exactly when 3 divides the side
claim: On the honeycomb torus of side n of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12,12) contacts (rings A(p), B(p), p in Z_n^2): (1) three steps of the contact graph between contacts of one type multiply by M = (1 + x)(1 + y/x)(1 + 1/y) = x + 1/x + y + 1/y + y/x + x/y over GF(2), so a contact needs a ring exactly when an odd number of walks of some length lead from one of its contacts, first at lag g k + 1; (2) ring A(p) never needs A(0) exactly when every power of M vanishes on p and its six neighbours, and B(p) exactly when every power vanishes on the six points p, p + e1, p + e2, p + e1 + e2, p + e2 - e1, p + e1 - e2; (3) every M^k, k >= 1, vanishes on the three mirror lines through the origin (directions (1,1), (-2,1), (1,-2)); (4) if 3 does not divide n, the ring B(t,t), t = -1/3 mod n, fixed by the turn of 120 degrees about A(0), never needs A(0) and A(0) never needs it, so composition never reaches every ring; (5) for n >= 7 the mirror lines contain no window of an A ring and contain the window of a B ring exactly when 3 does not divide n and the ring is B(t,t). Computed, not proved: every ring needs every ring on every side from 3 to 300 divisible by 3; when 3 does not divide n each ring is never needed by exactly 2(N - 1)(N - 2) + 1 rings, N = 2^(v2(n) + 1) (2^(v2(n) - 1) for powers of two), on sides 3 to 300.
failure_conditions: A side not divisible by 3 on which B(t,t) needs A(0).
A power M^k, k >= 1, nonzero at a point of a mirror line.
A mismatch between the library's contact graph or cell-level reads and the walk model.
Computed: a side divisible by 3 with a ring that never needs some ring, or a count that differs from 2(N - 1)(N - 2) + 1.
remaining_obligations: Prove full reach when 3 divides n (computed to side 300); on odd sides it reduces, by Theorem 5, to the points no power reaches being exactly the mirror lines (computed to side 299).
foundation_claim_scope: The honeycomb torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12,12) contacts; two-time knots only (A30); no distance.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's standing request on 2026-11-09.
validation.status: Theorems 1 to 5 proved by hand; finite claims checked by check.py; full reach when 3 | n and the count formula computed to side 300
validation.novelty: known-with-delta: composition across a honeycomb torus of rings is the powers of the six-neighbour sum over GF(2); the ring the turn of order 3 pins, which exists exactly when 3 does not divide the side, is never reached, as the antipode is on even square tori
